task: P(>= 1 mm rain tomorrow) from today's weather in a European city. Written from meteorology knowledge and UNLABELED feature percentiles only.

trees.why: persistence: a rainy day means a system is overhead and often still there tomorrow
rain still falling late in the evening: the system hasn't passed yet
falling barometer = low approaching; rising = high building
absolute pressure: lows are unsettled, highs are settled
dew point close to temperature in the evening (overlaps humidity, small weight)
warm sector: southerly flow while pressure falls, front on its way
strong evening wind goes with active systems
Mediterranean summer (Madrid, Rome; June-September) is reliably dry
